scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: design.read, section 'Errors and loggers', '### TypeScript' (lines 269-275): the console route is described as XclError implementing util.inspect.custom, with colour following Node's colors option. This matches the built [inspect.custom] in xcl-typescript/src/errors.ts (diff hunk at @@ -60,6 +66,10 and @@ -70,6 +80,28: returns the stack, or a coloured report when options.colors is true). The uncaught route is described as the plain report carried in the stack between the first line and the frames, with no process listener. This matches attachReport in the same diff (error.stack = header + report + frames), and the diff adds no process listener. Both routes are stated as the built behaviour, not as plans.
